app.title: EspressoIn - Tools (Band Structure)
app.summary: A person uploads a two-column band structure file from a plane-wave calculation, enters the Fermi energy so the energies are shifted to zero at the Fermi level, and optionally labels the high-symmetry points along the wave-vector path. The tool draws the bands, marks the valence band maximum and conduction band minimum, and computes the band gap, which can be shown under the title. The person then adjusts colours, line widths, markers, axis labels and tick spacing while watching a preview, and downloads the figure as an image in a chosen format and resolution.

task.text: Turn a computed band structure file into a labelled figure with its band gap, ready to download.

data.text: A whitespace-delimited numeric file with two columns, a position along the wave-vector path and an energy, where each band restarts the path at zero.
data.item: one band: its energies along the path through the Brillouin zone

stage.text: making a band structure figure after an electronic-structure calculation, for a write-up

mechanism.text: Upload and help sit in the main column; sidebar expanders hold data settings, plot styling and download settings, and every change redraws the single preview chart. A download button below the preview renders the same figure to a file.

field.text: electronic band structure plotting from Quantum ESPRESSO calculations in materials science

workflow.name: plot computed curves with a derived quantity and export a figure

steps.here: upload a .dat or .gnu band file (a sample file can be downloaded from the how-to panel); nothing else appears until a file is loaded

steps.step: set the reference value the data is measured against
steps.here: enter the Fermi energy from the SCF output, bounded by the file's energy range; all energies are shifted so the Fermi level sits at zero
choose how many high-symmetry points, then for each pick a symbol (Γ, M, X, K, …) or type a custom one and give its x-coordinate; these become the x tick labels

steps.step: compute a value from the data
steps.here: the band gap is taken as the distance between the highest energy below zero and the lowest above zero; both points are marked with dots and the gap can be shown under the title

steps.step: style the figure while watching a preview
steps.here: toggle grid and band-gap caption, pick band, marker and Fermi-line colours and widths, marker size, y tick increment, title and axis labels; the preview redraws on each change
choose jpg, png, tiff or svg, a DPI and an optional file name (defaults to the title), then Download Plot produces a download button for the image

distinctive: energies are shifted by a Fermi energy the person enters, and the band gap is read as the gap straddling zero
bands are split into separate lines wherever the path coordinate returns to zero
high-symmetry point labels come from a fixed set of Brillouin-zone symbols with a custom-label fallback
the valence band maximum and conduction band minimum are marked as dots on the curves
all interface text is switchable between three languages from JSON text files
